title: QAIRT and GenieX on QDC
route: QDC interactive session: learner-driven adb over an SSH tunnel (pivoted from the automated-job route on 2026-08-20; no API Keys tab in the learner's QDC account, SSH keys available)
cells_executed: command-line task, no notebook. Learner personally ran: the offline tests, the device-package build, the whole interactive session (SSH tunnel, adb pushes, chmod and .so staging, both geniex-bench runs at ctx 512 and 4096, adb pull, device cleanup, Complete Session), and the qdc_results recording command. Claude filled the session ID into tmp/commands.txt and diagnosed one tunnel failure (port 5037 held by the local adb server).

account_setup.qdc_rest_api_access: not available in this account's UI (SSH Keys tab only); automated-job route dropped
account_setup.qdc_sdk_wheel_version: 0.4.1 (installed and pinned in requirements-qdc.txt; unused after the pivot)

qdc_session.device: Snapdragon 8 Elite Mobile Reference Design (QRD8750, SM8750, Android 16)

parameters_changed.result: Nearly identical: decode 107.3 vs 108.2 tok/s, TTFT 20.1 vs 19.8 ms. Observation: context length did not change speed for this 0.6B model. Hypothesis (unproven): weight streaming dominates; KV attention width is a minor cost. Flagged for Task 09.

findings: Decode on the phone (~108 tok/s, ~9.2 ms/token full loop) beat the ~40 tok/s ceiling inferred from Task 07's profile (24.8 ms per part2 graph pass). Grounded contributor: the bundle's htp_backend_ext_config.json requests perf_profile 'burst', rpc_control_latency 100, shared_buffer memory, and weight sharing; the AI Hub profile job ran under its own default settings. Exact attribution unproven.
prompt_tokens reported 128 (= the prompt_ar128 graph size) although sample_prompt.txt is ~40 tokens; geniex-bench fills the prefill window.
sha256 of both context binaries matches the Task 07 manifest exactly: same bytes, new runtime.
